name: Eliab (a Reubenite)
title: Father of Dathan and Abiram
summary: Eliab was a Reubenite and the father of Dathan and Abiram, who joined Korah in rebelling against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness and were swallowed up by the earth.

keyEvents.title: Father of the rebels Dathan and Abiram
keyEvents.description: Eliab's sons Dathan and Abiram rebelled against Moses and were swallowed up by the earth.
